method: Episode/class-balanced binary cross entropy with L2 penalty around the parent prediction; 128 frozen camera-encoder features, 64 frozen hidden features and bias.
validation_operating_gate: Labeled tilt>=95 degrees and source outflow<3 nominal mL/s, an offline proxy for the existing runtime proprioception/visual-flow gate. All-angle errors also reported. No test data.

training_augmentation.scope: Source/wrist RGB training crops only; validation images and all simulator/video recordings remain native.
